message.content:
When you toss three fair coins, the number of heads you can observe ranges from **0 to 3** inclusive.  
In other words, the possible outcomes are:

| Heads | Probability |
|-------|-------------|
| 0     | 1/8         |
| 1     | 3/8         |
| 2     | 3/8         |
| 3     | 1/8         |

So you may end up with none, one, two, or all three heads.
